description:
[photos:/static/super/sup_usrail_advexp_1_main.jpg|/static/super/sup_usrail_advexp_2_route.jpg]

Fly-in transfers, luxury tented camps, guiding, park fees and all meals included.

description:
[photos:/static/super/sup_c2c_advexp_1_capetown.jpg|/static/super/sup_c2c_advexp_2_falls.jpg|/static/super/sup_c2c_advexp_3_game.jpg|/static/super/sup_c2c_advexp_4_pyramids.jpg|/static/super/sup_c2c_advexp_5_temple.jpg|/static/super/sup_c2c_advexp_6_bridge.jpg|/static/super/sup_c2c_advexp_7_bighole.jpg|/static/super/sup_c2c_advexp_8_giza.jpg]
The great Cape to Cairo rail journey — ten thousand kilometres and one continent, from Table Mountain to the Giza plateau. Winelands and Karoo, the thundering falls and the Zambezi bridge, game from the dining-car window, spice ports and Nubian villages, temples at dawn and the pyramids at the end of the line. Brass-and-teak sleepers, white-linen dining and a new country almost every day.
